extraction.Name: Jacob Anderson
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded March 14, 1919, but records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to John E. Moore on April 4, 1919; conveyed by deed to J. T. Payn for $7200, subject to the mortgage of $2400, which grantee assumed as part of the purchase price
extraction.NOTES: Southwest quarter of northeast quarter, southeast quarter of northwest quarter and lots 2 and 3, of section 32, township 95, range 72. Fee patent receipt was signed February 28, 1918, by the allottee. Conveyance to J. T. Payn dated June 12, 1919. Document also contains a second allottee entry: Clara Hudson, Allotment No. 3196, Rosebud, S.D., southwest quarter section 10, township 100, range 76; fee patent No. 612772 issued December 29, 1917; patent receipt signed by allottee February 13, 1918; patent recorded February 7, 1919, by the Volz Abstract Company; mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $2500 on December 5, 1918; conveyed by deed to Fritz A. Huddin for $12500, subject to mortgage of $2500 which grantee assumes as part of the purchase price, on July 8, 1919.
